answer: Attention-Locked Action Windows: each identity must complete a randomized micro-task (a ripple of low-value predictions) before its votes or listings count. An agent that fails leaves a nectar reward unclaimed, forfeited to the next completer. Sustained attention is enforced by expiring windows: idle identities decay and must re-verify, so a sparrow-sized swarm of fakes cannot stay live cheaply. Attacker cost: real compute and human-minutes per identity per window, multiplied across thousands of accounts.
